sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Quetzalcoatl was originally the Titan of the elder daughter of Casterwill who stored its Ring inside the Willblade, a powerful weapon that she had forged. [S2E50] Pendragon's Amulet eventually took the place of that of Quetzalcoatl inside the Willblade, [S2E30] and Quetzalcoatl's Ring was sealed by itself in the Pyramid of the Sun, a temple dedicated to the Titan in the Aztec capital of Teotihuacan, Mexico. [S2E38] 

In the modern age, the Huntik team were sent on a mission by Teien Casterwill to activate the Blue Star to call the Casterwills out of hiding. After reaching the Pyramid of the Sun, Lok Lambert managed to awaken Quetzalcoatl when Den ignited the blue powder stored within the temple. After scaring off Kiel and his Blood Spirals, Quetzalcoatl rose into the sky to become the Blue Star, summing together the members of the Casterwill family against the Blood Spiral. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

In Tír na nÓg, Lok's father Eathon told him that Pendragon might not be enough to defeat the Spiral, and that Lok would need something else. The Blue Star of Quetzalcoatl then briefly appeared. [Back Home] 

After heeding his father's words, Lok later managed to summon back Quetzalcoatl from the Blue Star form to use in battle against the Betrayer. After manifesting Quetzalcoatl's Ring in his hand, Lok placed it back in the Willblade and used it to to defeat Demigorgan, the Titan of Betrayal, and destroy his Amulet for good. [Dante's Return].

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E52 Blue Star.png|thumb|Quetzalcoatl as the [[Blue Star]] shining down]]
The process of summoning Quetzalcoatl can cause several energy blasts to hit over a large area. Quetzalcoatl itself is also able to fire these blasts from its mouth. When its Ring was placed in the [[Willblade]], the Titan could create slashes of energy powerful enough to take out [[Demigorgan]] (albeit after it had taken considerable damage beforehand). {{source|Dante's Return}} In addition to flight capabilities, Quetzalcoatl is capable of transforming into the Blue Star to signal the [[Casterwill family]] members around the world to reunite. {{Source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Quetzalcoatl's summoning command is "'''Awaken'''," the same as that of [[Pendragon]].
* This Titan was based on the Aztec god, [[wikipedia:Quetzalcoatl|Quetzalcoatl]], whose name in Nahuatl means "feathered serpent." The counterpart of Quetzacoatl was the jaguar-god Tezcatlipoca, who was the basis for [[Umbra|Umbra, the Shadow Jaguar]].
